mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id::text AS tenant_id, id::text AS id, provider_connection_id::text AS provider_connection_id, provider_connection_revision, model_code, display_name, model_type, array_to_string(capabilities, ',') AS capabilities, context_window, output_limit, embedding_dimension, status, version, created_at FROM model_runtime.model_deployment WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id}

SELECT tenant_id::text AS tenant_id, id::text AS id, provider_connection_id::text AS provider_connection_id, provider_connection_revision, model_code, display_name, model_type, array_to_string(capabilities, ',') AS capabilities, context_window, output_limit, embedding_dimension, status, version, created_at FROM model_runtime.model_deployment WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT tenant_id::text AS tenant_id, id::text AS id, provider_connection_id::text AS provider_connection_id, provider_connection_revision, model_code, display_name, model_type, array_to_string(capabilities, ',') AS capabilities, context_window, output_limit, embedding_dimension, status, version, created_at FROM model_runtime.model_deployment WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND (created_at, id) < (#{createdAt}, #{id}) ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
